title: AEIOU: A Unified Defense Framework against NSFW Prompts in Text-to-Image Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical security and safety defense framework (AEIOU) for detecting and interpreting NSFW prompts in generative models. While it discusses the importance of mitigating 'harmful' content (such as hateful or sexual imagery) as an ethical concern, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical systems themselves.
